summary: At segment 0 step 76, a polymorphed hero energy vortex engulfs the kobold shaman. C passes the successful AD_DREN roll from uhitm.c:gulpum() to mhitm.c:xdrainenergym(), which sees the target has an AT_MAGC attack and mspec_used below 20, adds d(2,2), and prints the lethargy message. JavaScript still skips that C helper. The complete direct-caller set also includes uhitm.c:mhitm_ad_dren(), reached through the AD_DREN arm of uhitm.c:mhitm_adtyping(); B accepted the earlier reservation, so this caller can now be claimed.

source.branch: mhitm.c:xdrainenergym() runs only when the target monster has mspec_used < 20 and has an AT_MAGC or AT_BREA attack. It adds d(2,2) to mspec_used and, when givemsg is true, calls pline_mon() with “seems lethargic.” C calls this helper directly from uhitm.c:gulpum() for an engulfing AD_DREN attack and from uhitm.c:mhitm_ad_dren() for hero-versus-monster and monster-versus-monster AD_DREN dispatch. The selected case reaches the gulpum() call; the mhitm_ad_dren() calls are routed through uhitm.c:mhitm_adtyping().
callers: uhitm.c:gulpum() at lines 5174-5177 calls xdrainenergym(mdef, TRUE) after a successful rn2(4) roll for an AD_DREN engulf. The selected v47 range reaches this direct call at step 76. JavaScript uhitm.js:gulpum() currently replaces the helper with note_unported.

uhitm.c:mhitm_ad_dren() at lines 2418-2442 calls xdrainenergym() in its hero-attacker and monster-attacker branches. The helper also handles the hero-defender branch by calling hitmsg() and drain_en(). Its direct caller is uhitm.c:mhitm_adtyping() case AD_DREN at line 4808; JavaScript currently refuses that arm.

uhitm.c:mhitm_adtyping() is called by uhitm.c:damageum(), mhitm.c:mdamagem(), and mhitu.c:hitmu(). Their existing JavaScript paths are uhitm.js:damageum(), mhitm.js:mdamagem(), and mhitu.js:hitmu(); all already dispatch through uhitm.js:mhitm_adtyping(). The task wires only its AD_DREN arm, plus the direct gulpum AD_DREN call.
dependencies: mondata.c:attacktype() is a pure catalog helper implemented by js/mondata.js.
rng.c:d() and rn2() are implemented by js/rng.js.
pline.c:pline_mon() is implemented by js/pline.js and carries the target monster location.
uhitm.c:mhitm_mgc_atk_negated() returns the cancellation result used by mhitm_ad_dren(); js/uhitm.js already implements it.
trap.c:drain_en() is called only in the hero-defender branch of mhitm_ad_dren(); js/trap_effects.js implements it.
uhitm.c:hitmsg() and display.c:canspotmon() are already wired in js/uhitm.js and js/display.js.
